detail.title: Independent Judgment vs Consensus: Initiating Evidence Collection
detail.summary: Initiating the systematic collection of literature on epistemic and peer disagreement to address the project's foundational question regarding when an intelligent system should prioritize its own conclusions.

children.title: epistemic disagreement peer disagreement consensus reliability formal epistemology literature

detail.reason: The next step for this project is to build an evidence base around the conditions under which independent judgment is epistemically justified in the face of consensus.
